set.body:
Source: 2026-07-25 review finding 6. Related to P6f.5a (fixture capture) but distinct: this is about contract validity, not provenance.

Two unverified assumptions, neither of which any current fixture can settle:

(a) SlurmCommands.accounting (cli/SlurmCommands.scala:53) passes --array to sacct. squeue has -r/--array; sacct is not believed to. If it does not, sacct exits non-zero on every call and all accounting fails. fixtures/sacct-array-contract-v1/provenance.json states the rows were derived from SchedMD documentation and that a live capture was attempted but unavailable.

(b) squeue --jobs=<id> exits 1 with "slurm_load_jobs error: Invalid job id specified" once a job leaves the queue. SlurmCliScheduler.queryResult (cli/SlurmCliScheduler.scala:202-204) maps any non-zero exit to InvocationFailed. If that is the real behavior then polling a job to completion -- the most common operation in the library -- ends in a transport-shaped failure, and a single terminal job fails an entire batched observe.

Acceptance:
- Confirm or refute both against real Slurm binaries; record exit codes, stdout, and stderr with provenance.
- If --array is invalid, remove it and re-derive the array accounting contract.
- If squeue exits non-zero for absent jobs, classify recognized "invalid job id" stderr as NotFound for the named jobs while preserving unknown non-zero exits as InvocationFailed, and keep any jobs squeue did return.
- Promote both to the front of docs/acceptance/p5-site-scale.md.
set.title: P6f.33: Verify the sacct and squeue CLI contracts against a real controller
